 PPB Seeks Public's Assistance Finding Missing Person 
 Label: 
 Press release
 View full size image
 of Missing Person news release graphic 
 The Portland Police Bureau's Missing Persons Unit is seeking help from the public to watch out for an endangered missing man in the Powellhurst-Gilbert Neighborhood. 
 Published October 24, 2026 2:29 pm 
 On Friday, October 23, 2026 at about 6:00 p.m., 60-year-old Yuriy Shevyakov left his home in the 12100 block of Holgate Boulevard. He has not returned home and efforts to locate him have not yet been successful. 
 View full size image
 of ID photo of Yuriy 
 Yuriy does not have needed medication to manage a medical condition. He is a Caucasian male, 5'7" in height, 150 lbs., last seen wearing a beige cap, checkered blue shirt, blue suit jacket, black pants, and black shoes. He does not have a phone or money but is familiar with the transit system. Yuriy primarily speaks Russian and has limited English proficiency. 
 Anyone who sees Yuriy is asked to call 911. Anyone with information about him that is not time sensitive is asked to email the Portland Police Missing Persons Unit at missing@police.portlandoregon.gov and reference case number 26-309433.
